description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hadira walana, Pahalagama, Kota vehera D/S/Division Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No.420351 (24/0301)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of title determinations for multiple land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with ownership information, property details, and encumbrances, which falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
